notablePrerequisites:
Araumi does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one additional card in your graveyard for each opponent you have.
Opponents are unable to block creatures you control.
description:
Activate Araumi by tapping it and exiling cards from your graveyard equal to the number of opponent you have, giving Clone encore until end of turn.
Activate Clone's encore ability by paying {3}{U} and exiling it, causing you to create a token copy with haste for each opponent you have.
Choose to have each Clone token enter the battlefield as a copy of Blightsteel Colossus.
Deal combat damage to each opponent using a Clone token, causing each opponent to get eleven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.
